answer: Use a capped delegation tree with rotating root keys. 1) Each account publishes a signed task commitment and bonds 36 POA for 14 days. 2) A public beacon assigns six randomized personalized jobs; two peers from disjoint funding paths audit hidden nonce outputs. 3) Any shared payout root, repeated response timing, or copied hash collapses descendants to one seat and slashes half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats immobilizes 36,000 POA, risks 18,000, and requires 6,000 jobs plus 12,000 audits. Like a mirror holding a sable relic, one root reflects every branch.
